comment: dokick.c really_kick_object() 549 and 619: a debug Valkyrie (no boots) wishes a cockatrice corpse onto the floor, polymorphs (#polyself) into a clay golem and kicks the corpse barefoot; poly_when_stoned() turns her into a stone golem and the kick continues (549). As a xorn she then drops her dagger inside the room's top wall, steps east into the wall, puts on a blindfold and kicks the dagger: the hero's own square is obstructed, so it never comes loose, and blind she gets 'It doesn't come loose.' (619).
